title: WebSec Campaign State
description: Campaign state. Current phase, active snapshots, artifact registry and counters are a working PROJECTION written alongside the append-only, hash-chained event log (events.jsonl) — hand-editing the projection is caught by audit_campaign (state tail vs log suffix, chain check, artifact re-hash).

completed_by.description: actor who marked the pass COMPLETE (webv2 complete); the decision itself is on the event log (campaign.completed)

completed_reason.description: written reason the pass was closed (webv2 complete)

policy_path.description: path to the bounty policy file for this program

budget.description: deterministic budget accounting; stages may be skipped when their budget class is exhausted

max_total_cost_usd.description: optional cost ceiling (operator-set). When set and exceeded, the pipeline halts: a cost overrun is a decision the operator must make explicitly, not a silent overrun.

snapshots.description: append-only: one entry per pinned snapshot, in pass order

artifacts.description: registry of every durable artifact with its id, kind and path — agents reference artifacts by id, never by pasting content

refreshed_at.description: last sanctioned re-hash; the artifact.refreshed log event carries the old->new hashes

floor_policy.description: INSTANCE-LEVEL evidence floor overrides: operator-stated policy data for THIS campaign (actor + reason + logged event), never a framework source edit. Consulted by findings.required_level_for_campaign for the CONFIRMED gate.

probe_blanks.description: BLANK ATTESTATIONS for the mechanical candidate plane: one named decision per probe lens whose axis is blind (sites > 0, rows = 0). Each entry cites a key the probe actually published in that axis's blind[] list, so 'the tree is clean' and 'the probe saw nothing it could rank' stay different, checkable claims. Written by `webv2 probes blank`; read by planner.divergence_status_for.

probe_axis.description: the probe AXIS NAME the attestation is for. A6: one lens may carry several probes (L-01 has three), so the schema-pinned `axis` field - the lens id - no longer identifies the axis; absent on entries written before the field existed.

eval_adjudications.description: NON-GOLD ADJUDICATIONS for live findings that match no gold anchor. The eval join calls every unanchored live finding a false positive; that conflates three different states of the world - the finding is wrong, the finding is right but absent from the gold dataset, or the finding rests on an assumption the campaign could not discharge. One row per finding, replacing any prior row for that finding. Written by webv2 adjudicate; read by internal/evalscore.

finding.description: the live finding id (F-xxxxxxxxxxxx) this row adjudicates

assumption.description: REQUIRED iff verdict is assumption-gated: the assumption that must hold for the finding to be real. Forbidden otherwise.

reason.description: a written reason of at least 10 chars that is not blank (evalscore.Validate trims before measuring, so whitespace-only text is not a reason)

stages.description: per-stage execution ledger: status, attempts, last model/stage ids. Discovery-stage sweep keys may name any discovery trajectory (code, economic, state-machine, attacker, historical, integration, drift, lifecycle, chain).

executor.description: 'deterministic' when the orchestrator ran it in-process

events.description: append-only, hash-chained event log; the source of truth for what happened. prev_hash/event_hash are optional only for logs written before the chain existed.

prev_hash.description: event_hash of the previous event, GENESIS (64 zeros) for the first, or a legacy-seq-N anchor over pre-chain events

event_hash.description: sha256 over {seq,at,type,ref,data,prev_hash}, canonical JSON, ensure_ascii, sorted keys
